entries.fw.coach_camera_body: Use + / − or scroll and pinch over the map to zoom. Drag the map to pan; Fit restores the view. The HUD stays the same size. Try the controls now. Q/E changes speed (1×–4×); tap the speed button to cycle.
entries.fw.coach_camera_title: Keep the whole route in view
entries.fw.coach_choose_body: Select Fire for burning splash damage. Frost slows, Storm chains lightning and hits dragons, and Earth breaks armor. Click a card or press 1–4.
entries.fw.coach_input_keyboard: Use 1–4 to choose a guardian, U to upgrade, Enter to start a wave, and WASD to pan. Escape skips the tour.
entries.fw.coach_input_pointer: Click the highlighted control or platform. Drag the map to pan; use the wheel or +/− to zoom. Skip is always available.
entries.fw.coach_input_touch: Tap the highlighted control or platform. Drag the map to pan and use +/− to zoom. You can skip at any time.
entries.fw.coach_place_body: Choose a guardian, then click an empty glowing root pad. The highlighted pad is a good first position. You can try it now, or continue without spending gold.
entries.fw.coach_route_body: Ink-shadow invaders follow the root road from the portal to this vault. Stop them before town health reaches zero. The gold line shows their route.
entries.fw.coach_start_body: Choose Enable battle tips to show guided callouts in your next battle. Then start or resume your campaign and choose a chapter. Your progress will not be reset.
entries.fw.coach_upgrade_body: Click a built guardian to inspect its role, range and upgrade cost. Upgrade adds power and changes its appearance. Every element has three visible tiers.
entries.fw.coach_wave_body: Goblins rush, orcs wear armor, trolls recover unless burning, and dragons fly. Each preparation lasts 30 seconds before the next wave auto-starts. Click Next wave or press Enter to start early. Pause stops the countdown. This tutorial also holds it; Finish tour returns to preparation.
entries.fw.defeat_body: A story is never lost while someone is willing to begin again.
entries.fw.empty: Your first legend is still unwritten.
entries.fw.enemy_broodmother_counter: Counter: Kill it early, freeze its spawn interval, or cover the rear with Fire splash.
entries.fw.enemy_broodmother_guide: A grounded root-and-ink beetle. Amber pods warn that it is about to release two ink-goblins behind itself.
entries.fw.enemy_harrier_counter: Counter: Frost slow or stun during the amber tell or dash cancels that burst cycle. Storm still prioritizes aerial foes.
entries.fw.enemy_harrier_guide: An airborne crystal-wing hunter. An amber ring is its 0.75-second burst tell; a pale trail marks its 1.75× dash.
entries.fw.enemy_prismback_counter: Counter: Keep landing hits to delay shell recovery, or use Earth; its physical damage bypasses the crystal shell.
entries.fw.enemy_prismback_guide: A grounded armored behemoth. Its azure shell absorbs resolved Arts damage, then rebuilds after four seconds without a hit.
entries.fw.hard_mode_hint: Hard: Prismback, Harrier and Broodmother have +50% HP; their scheduled arrivals are 25% closer together; +1 late-enemy reinforcement for every 3 authored late enemies in each wave (round up). Other enemies and Broodmother children are unchanged.
entries.fw.hard_mode_summary: Late enemies +50% HP · arrive faster and more numerous.
entries.fw.hard_mode_weakness: Hard mode keeps the same weaknesses: Earth pierces Prismback’s shell; Frost disrupts Harriers; Fire covers Broodmother’s children.
entries.fw.hint_keys: 1–4 choose · U upgrade · Q/E speed · Enter wave · Space/Esc pause · drag pan · scroll zoom
entries.fw.intro: The ink has escaped. Raise elemental guardians, hold the roots, and keep the Last Seed alight.
entries.fw.merge_cancel_hint: Cancel and restore both original guardians.
entries.fw.merge_channels: Both elements retain their own attack timing and abilities. Shared range uses the larger source range.
entries.fw.merge_first: Choose a level-3 basic or a dual-element guardian.
entries.fw.merge_no_overlap: These guardians share an element. Worldheart needs all four, with no overlap.
entries.fw.merge_place: 3 / 3 · Choose an empty root socket to place your merged guardian.
entries.fw.merge_requirement: Merge two different Lv.3 basics, or two dual guardians with no shared element.
entries.fw.merge_safety: No gold cost. Cancel restores both towers. Wave preparation waits; active combat continues.
entries.fw.merge_same_kind: Pair basics with basics, or dual guardians with dual guardians.
entries.fw.merge_second: 2 / 3 · Choose a level 3 guardian of a different element. Tap the first again to deselect.
entries.fw.merge_second_dual: Choose a dual guardian with no overlapping element to summon Worldheart.
entries.fw.next_wave_hint: Start now · Enter. Otherwise auto-starts after 30 seconds of preparation. Pausing stops the countdown.

entries.fw.threats_intro: Watch the battlefield tells, then use the right elemental answer before these threats reach the Last Seed.
entries.fw.threats_tower_rules: Earth hits ground only and its physical damage bypasses Prismback’s shell. Frost slows ground and air, and can cancel a Harrier burst. Storm chains lightning and retains aerial priority. Fire splashes ground foes, burns trolls, and is strong cover for Broodmother’s rear-spawned goblins.

entries.fw.tutorial_1: Protect the Last Seed. Choose Fire below, then tap an empty glowing socket beside the parchment road.
entries.fw.tutorial_2: Select a built guardian to upgrade it. Each of its three tiers changes its shape and grows stronger.
entries.fw.tutorial_3: Start each wave when ready. Fire and Earth hold the ground; Frost slows; Storm prioritizes dragons. Drag to pan, scroll or pinch to zoom.
entries.fw.tweak_note: Local preview tuning · next chapter for gameplay changes
entries.fw.ultimate_fire_earth_desc: Every 16s: a quake hits up to 8 nearby ground foes for 3× armor-piercing damage. Roots for 1.5s; burns for 4s.
entries.fw.ultimate_fire_frost_desc: Every 12s: a nova hits up to 8 nearby foes for 2× combined damage. Freezes for 1s; ground foes burn for 3s.
entries.fw.ultimate_fire_frost_storm_earth_desc: 20s recharge · 1s flight · radius 3. Up to 12 foes take 5× elemental damage: freeze 1s, slow 3s, ground burn 4s. Lightning hits 3 more.
entries.fw.ultimate_fire_storm_desc: Every 14s: lightning chains through up to 6 foes for 3× damage. Air priority; ground foes burn for 4s.
entries.fw.ultimate_frost_earth_desc: Every 18s: a 5s ice grove hits up to 8 foes each second for ½× damage and slows for 2s. Hits ground and air.
entries.fw.ultimate_frost_storm_desc: Every 12s: three volleys, 0.5s apart, each hit up to 4 foes for 1× damage and slow for 2s. Air priority.
entries.fw.ultimate_storm_earth_desc: Every 15s: roots 4 ground foes for 2s with 2× armor-piercing damage; shocks 2 air foes for 3× damage and slows for 2s.
entries.fw.ultimate_timing: Charges only while a wave has living enemies. Holds at Ready until a target enters range. Timers follow combat speed and freeze during pause.
entries.fw.upgrade_hint: Upgrade selected guardian when affordable · U
entries.fw.victory_body: You held the roots. Another chapter lives to be told.
